title: Quadratic-residuosity symbol
statement: For natural numbers $N$ and $A$, define the quadratic-residuosity symbol to be $0$ when $A$ and $N$ are not coprime; when they are coprime, it is $1$ if the residue class of $A$ in $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ is a square, and $-1$ otherwise.
